svg.title: Tankers make up 72% of large-ship visits at Sabine-Neches and 58% at Houston-Galveston; cargo and container ships lead everywhere else

cc:Work.dc:title: Tankers make up 72% of large-ship visits at Sabine-Neches and 58% at Houston-Galveston; cargo and container ships lead everywhere else
cc:Work.dc:description: Marimekko chart of the 12 busiest port complexes with column width set by share of port visits and column height split by ship type; tanker share is highest in the Gulf complexes and cargo share highest in the Atlantic and Pacific complexes.
